newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady, some demand seen.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady, some demand seen.

text.p: NWE oil products were broadly steady on Friday. Naphtha held steady in quiet trade, but bid/ask ranges widened as weaker gas oil pressured crude futures. Gasoline was steady at the lower levels. Barges clawed back some of their early losses while underlying arbitrage interest buoyed high octane cargoes, traders said.

Gas oil eased around $4.00 with futures on Friday, but demand for diesel and German heating oil remained very strong, they added. Fuel oil was steady even though certain players tried to push prices down but a fundamental lack of product gave support. U.S. interest for low sulphur straight-run continued.
